basic_info.description: Classic corner apartment building in the heart of the Mission District. Just off Valencia St, 195 Lexington is comprised of 9 large one-bedroom units, a 2-car garage and a large ground floor with several storage rooms (2 units are currently vacant). Just two blocks from Dolores Park, the location offers tenants all the amazing cultural and neighborhood amenities the Mission has to offer, from popular retail shops and restaurants to a thriving nightlife and community gathering spots. Most units are leased at or near market rents; several are fully renovated. The property is a well maintained building and consists of 6,984 square feet.
